author: Sergei Wallace
text:
FOUNDING-ASK AMENDMENT (Sergei, 2026-10-23T23:37:48Z; verbatim in the BU-ylx comment of that time). The beads-ui task panel sits where the CC task panel sits and is a small app inside the Claude Code TUI:
- Navigate up and down, including into collapsed tasks beyond the ones shown. How many to show and how many to collapse is set in a config file and can be changed from the beads-ui TUI itself.
- Select a task to open its details and edit its fields.
- A popup options menu and keyboard shortcuts, with every action reachable from both, and with mouse control (left and right click).
- A shortcut that moves the cursor from the Claude Code prompt box into the beads-ui panel, then back. /orchestrate a /research-doc if it is unclear whether or how that is possible.
- Later views: kanban board, sprint and backlog, timeline, and the other Jira, Todoist and Asana-style features, reached from a menu bar or side nav, with a settings view.

author: Sergei Wallace
text: 2026-10-24T01:05Z, ops-vm-3 Opus coordinator. Designed on beads-ui main (PR #38, 8a0708f): Phase 2B of docs/designs/beads-ui-design.md is the task panel that replaces the Claude Code task panel, with tasks T-2B.1 to T-2B.9 and decisions D-31 (element tree plus a Client for the list and board, element-tree fallback), D-32 (a docked panel under panel.mode, both by default; cutover by the per-profile retirement switch) and D-33 (the mod runs a configured sync command after a 10-second quiet; any failure starts a turn in the session through $.prompt.submit with a fixed, truncated template, deduplicated, retries capped, plus a terminal notification). Research behind it: docs/research/claude-code-mod-panel-rendering-and-focus.md (PR #37). Build follows Phase 1B.
